sections.text_helper: Section 19.7.9 "XSPI address register (XSPI_AR)" in chapter 19 (Extended-SPI interface (XSPI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 537.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x048
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can be modified only when BUSY = 0 and FMODE ≠ 11.
Bits 31:0 ADDRESS[31:0]: Address
Address to be sent to the external device. In dual-memory configuration, AR[0] is forced to 0.
Caution: Some memory specifications consider that each address corresponds to a 16-bit
value. XSPI considers that each address corresponds to an 8-bit value. So the
software needs to multiply the address by two when accessing the memory
registers.
